pr.title: Fix Windows dynamic debug E2E teardown race
pr.author: ellahathaway

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows) / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows)
failed_jobs.reason: Job fails with a generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' and no retrievable logs or TRX test failures. This matches a previously recorded recurring flaky failure pattern (vscode-extension-unit-tests-windows-flaky, issue #19270) and is unrelated to the PR's E2E-only test file changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (collection, Aspire.Hosting.Tests, Hosting-4, Hosting-4, tests/Aspire.Hosting.Te... / Hosting-4 (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Test PipelineConfigurationContext_GetStepsByResourceAndTag_ReturnsCorrectSteps fails with UnauthorizedAccessException during the 'destroy' pipeline step on Windows. This matches a known recurring flaky pattern (aspire-hosting-pipelinetests-destroy-access-denied-windows, issue #20078) caused by transient file-system access issues on Windows CI runners, and is unrelated to the PR, which only modifies VS Code extension E2E test files.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Both failing tests time out (~299s) waiting for the Blazor WASM root debug session for 'hosted-global' and 'hosted-per-page' resources. This matches a known recurring flaky pattern (vscode-extension-e2e-blazordebugger-timeout-linux, issue #20184) affecting the browser-debugger E2E shard on Linux, and is unrelated to the PR's changes, which target only the dynamic-debug and Windows teardown E2E test files.
